posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked:
As we near the end of this Kickstarter, I remember that the previous Kickstarter was also well funded (at $111k of $20k).  That also reminded me of the first Kickstarter, when the game was very new (having been release just a month prior at GenCon), which only had a stated goal of $12k, 45 days to fund (rather than the 30 days for the other two), and made $27k.  Just shy of $28k which would have more art released, and the $30k which would have given everyone a T-shirt.  Everyone was so excited about possibly getting $40k, which would have given us Mad Bomber Blade much earlier (I can only assume it was Mad Bomber Blade).

One thing that has me intrigued is what would have happened at the $50k level.  It was listed as a stretch reward, and it had been stated that if they were to raise such funds, they'd be beside themselves, and that they have an amazing product that they’d like to produce that this would help fund and would directly improve everyone’s Sentinels of the Multiverse experience.  They said it was a far off dream, but, in the following kickstarter, they managed to double funding, and with this one they may have even tripled that amount.  I really want to know what this amazing and helpful product would have been.

posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked: Maybe the $50K would have been oversized villain cards?

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: It was a combo of oversized villain cards and what became the Enhanced Edition box. We wound up scrapping the stand-alone upgrade in favor of the full Enhanced Edition, since we had to reprint the game any way after selling out.
